mapper.select: SELECT c.user_id,c.cash_balance,c.updated_at,COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.freeze_amount) FROM trade_order o WHERE o.user_id=c.user_id AND o.status=1 AND o.deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000'),0) AS frozen_amount FROM cash_account c WHERE c.user_id=#{userId} AND c.deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000'
SELECT * FROM trade_order WHERE ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}
SELECT * FROM trade_order WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id} AND deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000'

SELECT i.*,COALESCE(f.fund_code,'') AS fund_code,COALESCE(f.name,'已下架基金') AS fund_name FROM trade_order_item i LEFT JOIN fund f ON f.id=i.fund_id WHERE i.deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' AND i.order_id IN #{id} ORDER BY i.id
SELECT * FROM ta_receipt WHERE deleted_at='1970-01-01 00:00:00.000' AND order_id IN #{id}
